extracted.name: Spicy Mayo
extracted.description: This spicy sriracha mayo recipe is a quick and easy way to jazz up sushi, tacos, burgers, and more! Find our favorite serving suggestions in the post above.
instruction_lines: In a small bowl, stir together the mayonnaise, sriracha, lime juice, and sesame oil. Taste and adjust as desired.
Use as a sauce for these sushi bowls, this vegan sushi, or your favorite sushi recipe. Find more serving suggestions in the post above.
